before the doctor, during investigation as well as before the trial court that the applicant, after disrobing her, committed rape upon her.
7-The Apex Court, in the case of X vs. State of Rajasthan and Another, 2024 SCC OnLine SC 3539,
has held that if the trial of the accused has started, his bail should not be granted in heinous offences like murder, rape and dacoity.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Since the offence is heinous in nature and trial of the applicant has started and victim has made allegation of rape against the applicant as noted above, therefore, the bail application of the applicant is not liable to be allowed.
8-Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
9-It is made clear that the observation contained in the instant order is confined to the issue of bail and shall not affect the merit of the trial.
